theorems.name: Submission.dorag_tes_lipschitz_graph_area_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ξ : Euclid (n + k)) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (h : Euclid (n + k) → ℝ≥0∞), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v w, ‖f v - f w‖ ≤ ‖v - w‖) → MeasurableSet A → Measurable h → (∫⁻ v in A, h (ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) ≤ ∫⁻ x in (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' A, h x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ x in (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' A, h x ∂μHE[n] ≤ ∫⁻ v in A, ENNReal.ofReal (1 + 2 ^ n * ∑ i : Fin n, ‖fderiv ℝ f v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) * h (ξ + ι v + ι' (f v))
